name: Kevin Marsh

summary.text: Kevin Marsh was chairman and chief executive of SCANA Corporation during the construction of two reactors at the V.C. Summer nuclear station, abandoned in 2017. On February 24, 2021 he pleaded guilty in federal court to conspiracy to commit mail and wire fraud, admitting he defrauded ratepayers so SCANA could keep rate increases and qualify for up to $2.2 billion in tax credits; he also pleaded guilty to a state charge. On October 7, 2021 he was sentenced to 24 months, three years of supervision and a $200,000 fine, having forfeited $5 million.
